Precondition: JabilEye online; admin connected; recognition running
Steps: Lock system; show authorized face above threshold
Expected Result: Lock widget stays on top; camera preview is live; system unlocks only after authorized face match; input restrictions are released after unlock

Precondition: JabilEye online; system locked
Steps: Show unknown or unauthorized face
Expected Result: Cant Unlock

Precondition: Disable keyboard and mouse while locked; JabilEye online
Steps: Lock system; try keyboard and mouse; show authorized face
Expected Result: Keyboard/mouse are blocked while locked; face unlock still works; keyboard/mouse restore after unlock

Precondition: JabilEye online; system locked
Steps: Power off JabilEye or disconnect network
Expected Result: Lock widget stays open; camera preview changes to disconnected message; reconnect prompt appears; system does not unlock or crash

Area: Locked JabilEye offline with keyboard/mouse disabled
Precondition: Disable keyboard/mouse; JabilEye online; system locked
Steps: Power off JabilEye or disconnect network
Expected Result: User is not required to click anything; app keeps retrying; input stays blocked; lock widget remains visible; reconnect prompt does not create an unusable path

Precondition: From LOCK-004 or LOCK-005 state
Steps: Restart JabilEye or restore network
Expected Result: App detects reconnection; disconnect prompt changes to connected/then closes; camera preview resumes; face unlock works

Precondition: Wrong JabilEye hostname configured; keyboard/mouse disabled
Steps: Lock system
Expected Result: System remains locked; no crash; preview unavailable; recovery requires JabilEye hostname correction or emergency/admin policy

Precondition: System locked; JabilEye goes offline
Steps: Observe lock widget and disconnect prompt
Expected Result: Lock safety remains highest priority; user cannot close lock widget manually; reconnect status remains visible and understandable

Precondition: System locked; emergency hotkey enabled
Steps: Trigger configured emergency unlock
Expected Result: Only the approved emergency path unlocks; input restrictions are released; action is logged with actor/time

Precondition: Valid hostname; JabilEye available
Steps: Press Connect
Expected Result: Button shows loading; success prompt appears; status is Connected; preview and status agree

Precondition: Wrong hostname or JabilEye offline
Steps: Press Connect
Expected Result: Button shows loading; failure prompt appears; app does not crash; status is Disconnected; preview is cleared

Precondition: JabilEye connected; app unlocked
Steps: Power off JabilEye or disconnect network
Expected Result: Status changes to Disconnected; disconnect prompt appears even if app was minimized; camera preview clears

Precondition: From UNLOCK-003 state
Steps: Restore JabilEye/network
Expected Result: Status changes to Connected; prompt closes after connected message; preview resumes only after session is accepted

Area: Admin change hostname from disconnect prompt
Precondition: Admin signed in; JabilEye disconnected prompt visible
Steps: Click Change hostname
Expected Result: Main window restores if minimized; Settings opens; hostname textbox focused; reconnect prompt does not cover typing

Area: Guest change hostname from disconnect prompt
Precondition: Guest/not signed in; JabilEye disconnected prompt visible
Steps: Click Change hostname
Expected Result: Login prompt appears; without admin login Settings is not accessible

Precondition: Normal non-admin signed in; JabilEye disconnected prompt visible
Steps: Click Change hostname
Expected Result: Admin login required; normal user cannot access Settings

Precondition: JabilEye already connected/owned by another SAS client
Steps: Enter same JabilEye hostname; press Connect
Expected Result: This client receives connect failure; status remains Disconnected; preview does not open; WebSocket does not open; user sees failure message

Precondition: Another SAS client owns JabilEye; this app is unlocked
Steps: Press Connect repeatedly
Expected Result: No duplicate session is created; no camera preview appears; app remains stable; log records connection failure

Precondition: Another SAS client owns JabilEye; this app failed to connect
Steps: Close/disconnect the owning SAS client; retry or wait for retry
Expected Result: This app can connect after JabilEye releases ownership; preview starts only after /sas/connect succeeds

Precondition: Another SAS client owns JabilEye; this app locked
Steps: Start locked recognition/retry
Expected Result: System remains locked; no preview from unauthorized session; reconnect/ownership error is shown; app does not unlock

Precondition: This app previously showed camera; then loses ownership or /sas/connect fails
Steps: Reconnect to same hostname while another client owns JabilEye
Expected Result: Old preview frame is cleared; UI does not display stale camera image as if connected

Precondition: Valid JabilEye hostname; JabilEye AJABILEYE available
Steps: Press Connect; open Dashboard, Face Recognition, Face Data, Log
Expected Result: HTTP AJABILEYE calls succeed from all pages; no page requires an extra reconnect to refresh data; status remains Connected

Precondition: JabilEye hostname valid but AJABILEYE stopped or blocked
Steps: Press Connect or refresh a JabilEye-backed page
Expected Result: User sees a clear failure prompt; app stays open; status becomes Disconnected; no password or sensitive detail is shown

Precondition: JabilEye video endpoint reachable but /sas/connect or websocket fails
Steps: Press Connect
Expected Result: Camera preview does not make the app say Connected by itself; Connected appears only when SAS session/API/websocket state is accepted

Precondition: JabilEye connected; system locked; authorized face registered
Steps: Lock system; scan authorized face
Expected Result: Unlock event received through websocket unlocks system; event is logged; preview and lock widget close correctly

Precondition: JabilEye connected; system locked
Steps: Restart JabilEye app service or disconnect/reconnect network
Expected Result: Websocket reconnects; locked preview resumes; system can still unlock after reconnect without restarting SAS

Precondition: JabilEye connected; JabilEye has registered users
Steps: Open Face Recognition page without pressing Connect again
Expected Result: Authorized users list loads from JabilEye automatically; Users badge count matches list count

Precondition: JabilEye connected; local folder exists
Steps: Face Data; choose Export to local; browse folder; Export
Expected Result: Indeterminate/running state appears; ZIP downloads to selected local folder; success prompt shows saved path

Precondition: JabilEye connected; SMB path and credentials available
Steps: Face Data; choose Export to SMB/server path; enter username/password/path; Export
Expected Result: Credentials are sent only for this operation; ZIP is created by JabilEye at SMB path; fields clear after operation; log has no password

Precondition: Camera connected; valid local .zip available
Steps: Face Data; choose Import from local; browse file picker
Expected Result: Picker accepts .zip only; import loads ZIP into the local SAS dataset; user list refreshes after success

Precondition: Camera connected; valid SMB ZIP path and credentials available
Steps: Face Data; choose Import from SMB/server path; enter username/password/path; Import
Expected Result: SAS imports selected ZIP from SMB path; fields clear after operation; user list refreshes after success; log has no password

Precondition: Guest or normal user
Steps: Try open Face Recognition, Face Data, Log, Settings
Expected Result: Admin-only pages are disabled or require admin; Dashboard remains accessible

Precondition: Admin signed in
Steps: Open Face Recognition, Face Data, Log, Settings
Expected Result: Admin can access all management pages

Precondition: Use app normally
Steps: Open pages; change settings; register/delete user; import/export face data; download logs
Expected Result: SAS log records time, actor, action, and details without passwords

Precondition: Log page open
Steps: Enter/browse destination; Download SAS log
Expected Result: Today's SAS_LOG_yyyyMMdd.txt is copied to chosen local/SMB path accessible by Windows

Precondition: App has daily logs older than retention period
Steps: Start app
Expected Result: SAS_LOG files older than 90 days are removed automatically; current logs remain
